title: Helwit Mocha Nicotine Pouches 9mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Mocha Nicotine Pouches serve up a comforting combination of chocolate and coffee, with caramel tones rounding out the flavour. It’s a warm, indulgent option that delivers the richness of a mocha without any of the sugar or mess. With 9mg of nicotine per pouch, this variant suits users seeking a stronger level of satisfaction. The slim pouches are made from soft, plant-based fibres and provide a steady, discreet nicotine release with no smoke, vapour or lingering smell. A flavourful pouch that feels like a coffee break in your pocket. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
